selection.ownership: Benzinga, One Campus Martius Suite 200, Detroit, Michigan 48226, United States. Majority owned by Beringer Capital since October 2021. Not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official Benzinga REST at https://api.benzinga.com, token query authentication, GET /api/v2.1/news/channels as pinned credential validator, calendar earnings and ratings, consensus-ratings, Detroit identity and Beringer Capital majority acquisition (2021-10-25), and dated incident search for Benzinga security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Benzinga coverage of other companies' breaches is not a Benzinga platform compromise. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official docs require token as a query parameter on https://api.benzinga.com. News channels is a catalog read used by the pinned validator rather than a billed quote lookup. Calendar earnings/ratings and consensus-ratings are documented GETs. Operator is Detroit-based Benzinga, majority acquired by Beringer Capital in October 2021. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved Benzinga platform compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Benzinga security breach and incident coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-credential compromise. Benzinga articles about other companies' data breaches were distinguished from a Benzinga platform incident.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
